head: codex/5662-v0918-unity-observatory-polish
title: [v0.91.8][WP-15][unity][demo] Polish flagship Polis Observatory visual and runtime presentation
body:
Closes #5662

## Summary
- ground and visually polish the flagship Unity Polis Observatory environment
- deliver a fixed investor-facing dashboard with clear navigation, bounded internal scrolling, and fail-closed state labels
- support the current Runtime v3 Observatory feed contract with HTTPS endpoint policy, bearer-header construction, exact signed-control truth, strict legacy compatibility, and visible parsed projections
- retain exact Full HD and QHD Play Mode evidence without publishing licensed source assets or building a player/replacement runtime binary

## Focused proof
- Unity-MCP `ObservatoryMcpProof.Run`: `flagship-stage-and-runtime-shell-valid`
- `bash adl/tools/test_v0916_unity_observatory_contract.sh`
- `git diff --check`
- exact 1920x1080 and 2560x1440 capture dimensions and SHA-256 identities recorded in the proof packet
- bounded subagent review PASS with all eleven findings fixed

## Truth boundary
The final captures are explicitly DEMO / FIXTURE. Runtime v3 proof is executable in-editor endpoint policy, bearer-header construction, parser, classifier, and UI projection proof; it is not a live HTTPS listener exchange. Rendering depends on operator-provisioned licensed assets outside Git.
